items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the location of a place near 'Lula White's' as mentioned by the interviewer, showing no personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: Oh, he ran that place there.

He used to run at that time, you know. Used to have, he's a policeman. Oh, it's close to Lula White's. Yeah, close to Lula White's. That's right. And it's still there now, yeah. It's there, yeah, now, but it's a grocery store.
It's a grocery store. It's a grocery store. Mm-hmm.
